text:
Aisha: Heads up — after toggling te_quant_fastpath on the L40S pool we saw a p99 jump for long-context requests (~6k-8k tokens) in canary. Need help sleuthing.
Ben: Which change exactly? PR or runtime flag?
Aisha: Runtime flag + small kernel selector tweak. Flip was: transformer_engine.te_quant_fastpath = true and selector preferring fp8_fast on L40S.
Kai: Repro attached in profiler. p50 ~= 95ms, p95 ~= 340ms, p99 ~= 1.1s for 8k context; baseline p99 was ~620ms. Throughput down ~18%.
Ravi: Also seeing more KV cache evictions when kernel switches mid-request. Cache hotness metric drops ~22% after a kernel flip. Logs show eviction spikes due to layout mismatch on handoff.
Sloane: Can you paste the selector rules and eviction thresholds you pushed?
Aisha: sure:
```
kernel_selector:
  - rule: if seq_len > 2048 and hw == L40S then use: fp8_fast
  - rule: else use: fp8_stable
cache_policy:
  kv_eviction_threshold: 0.7
  warmstart_grace: 30s
transformer_engine:
  te_quant_fastpath: true
  flash_attn_mode: auto
```
Ben: hmm warmstart_grace 30s seems low for long-context workloads. When the selector flips we reallocate KV backing and remap shards which causes short stalls and extra eviction churn.
Kai: Reprofiled locally with warmstart_grace = 120s and pinned fp8_stable during warmstart. Result: p99 fell to ~700ms, throughput recovered ~8%. Spike amplitude reduced.
Ravi: Quality delta fp8_stable vs fp8_fast is small in aggregate: mean token logprob shift ~0.06 across our eval set, but we observed occasional edge-case deltas up to ~0.18 on very long contexts.
Sloane: Proposed heuristic: pin to stable kernel during warmstart and delay eviction until steady-state. e.g. warmstart_grace = max(30s, seq_len / 100 tokens) to scale with context size.
Aisha: I ran a quick AB: warmstart_grace=120s + pin_stable_on_warmstart eliminated the kernel-flip-induced cache thrash and the p99 regression. Repro script + traces: https://perf.internal/runs/2467890000-ab1
infra-bot: deploy started: canary group h100-l40s-precision-rollback 2467890012
Ben: Next action items: 1) Add kernel pinning during warmstart; 2) Increase grace window for long contexts; 3) Emit telemetry when kernel flip occurs with KV eviction_count metric; 4) Add regression alert if p99 > 900ms for >= 5m.
Kai: I'll open a PR for selector fallback and the telemetry ping. Assigning review to @Ben.
Ravi: Also add a calibration audit: re-run FP8 scale calibration across batches immediately after any kernel flip to validate no scale drift.
Sloane: Canary dashboard shows p99 trending down after the rollback patch. We'll keep monitoring for 30m.
Aisha: thanks all :thumbsup:
